name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Publish README badges (main only — data lives on the 'badges' branch)

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  running="$(installed_version)"","oldText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Publish README badges (main only — data lives on the 'badges' branch)

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel

        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  running="$(installed_version)"","oldText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

var tsIdentity = function (t) { return t; };

that top-level function is a separate coverage unit. If never called anywhere in the suite → 0% coverage but complexity 1 → CRAP = 1^2 * (1-0)^3 + 1 = 2 (or with comp=2: 4*1+2=6). name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

messages.preview: Now the core v-pin fix — derive the pin from what `resolve_target` already resolved instead of re-reading the raw file:

blocks.text: Now the core v-pin fix — derive the pin from what `resolve_target` already resolved instead of re-reading the raw file:

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  running="$(installed_version)"","oldText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

messages.preview: Now the core v-pin fix — derive the pin from what `resolve_target` already resolved instead of re-reading the raw file:

blocks.text: Now the core v-pin fix — derive the pin from what `resolve_target` already resolved instead of re-reading the raw file:

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  running="$(installed_version)"","oldText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel

        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

blocks.text: Now the core v-pin fix — derive the pin from what `resolve_target` already resolved instead of re-reading the raw file:

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;

Hmm wait — maybe the docs were ALREADY stale on main? Let me check: does main's generated docs have the setupCommands bullet? Let me test on origin/main directly... Actually simpler: `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- docs/agents/generated` — was empty (PR didn't touch them). And the CI was green on main. So on main, generator output == committed docs. On the PR branch, generator output ≠ committed docs. The delta must come from a JS source change in the PR. The PR changed:
- js/common/toolchainSummary.js (new — contains "customParams.setupCommands" IN A COMMENT! Line 20: `*  2. runs it at POST time — the leg preamble (customParams.setupCommands`)
- js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js

- js/unit-tests/*

`extractCustomParamsPaths(src)` greps the ACTION SOURCE files with regex `/customParams\.([a-zA-Z_$][\w$]*(?:\.[a-zA-Z_$][\w$]*)/g` — INCLUDING COMMENTS! The new toolchainSummary.js comment contains `customParams.setupCommands`. And which generated docs reference toolchainSummary.js? pushReworkChanges.js requires it (pr_rework.md) and developTicketAndCreatePR.js requires it (bug_development, story_development, story_development_dynamic_repo). Fix: reword the comment in toolchainSummary.js to not match the regex — e.g. write it as "customParams setupCommands" (no dot) or "setupCommands in customParams". Then the generated docs are fresh without regeneration. Let me verify after the change.

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  running="$(installed_version)"","oldText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  running="$(installed_version)"","oldText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same

{"newText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
  # precedence), so the summary describes the toolchain the session runs.
  resolve_target ""

  # The CI slot reports the repo's pin — taken from what resolve_target
  # ALREADY consumed, never from a raw re-read of the pin source (review
  # gh-1137: the raw token carried a muscle-memory `v` prefix the install
  # path strips, so the summary claimed match: no while the leg provably ran
  # the pinned SDK). On a repo-sourced target the resolved VERSION/CHANNEL IS
  # the pin; on an operator override (argument/environment/default) the CI
  # slot still reports the repo's own pin, v-stripped like resolve_target does.
  local pin pin_kind="version" running effective match
  case "${SOURCE}" in
    "version file"|"quality workflow")
      if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
        pin="${VERSION}"
      else
        pin="${CHANNEL}"
        pin_kind="channel"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      pin="$(repo_version_pin)"
      pin="${pin#v}"
      case "${pin}" in stable|beta|dev) pin_kind="channel" ;; esac
      if [ -z "${pin}" ]; then
        local det det_sdk det_channel
        det="$(quality_detection)"
        det="${det#*|}"
        det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"
        if [ -n "${det_sdk}" ]; then
          pin="${det_sdk#v}"; pin_kind="version"
        elif [ -n "${det_channel}" ]; then
          pin="${det_channel}"; pin_kind="channel"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  running="$(installed_version)"","oldText":"  # Resolve the leg's target exactly like the install path does (same
